messages:
julia: Postmortem follow-up : still seeing overnight churn from 3 families: proxy-conns, scheduler-burst, cache-hotkey. Need owners and short, testable changes. @alert-bot can you post 72h counts?

alert-bot: 72h snapshot: proxy_conns=46, scheduler_burst=33, cache_hotkey=19. Top services: inference-proxy, batch-scheduler, cache-layer. Link: https://redwood.internal/alerts/1775551234

kevin: I'll own proxy_conns. Quick fixes: bump upstream pool by 15%, add connect jitter, and only page when avg_conn_latency>200ms. Target: infra PR by Tue EOD. Will set owner=kevin tag.

liam: I'll take scheduler_burst. Plan: cap prefetch at 800, change alert to p95(backlog,5m) > 900, and add suppression when label ingest_burst=true. Lab PR Wed. Canary Thu.

mona: I'll handle cache_hotkey dedupe. Fix: exact-key dedupe with window=12m, add hot-key histogram and dashboard tile. PR Wed EOD.

julia: constraints: dedupe windows should be conservative (10-15m), require 72h post-rollout monitoring, and each PR must include a one-line smoke test for oncall.

kevin: smoke snippet for proxy dedupe:```bash
for i in 1 2 3; do curl -H "X-Test-Key: dedupe-proxy" https://proxy-canary.internal/ping; done
# expect: 1 pager within 15m
```

liam: scheduler smoke will fire synthetic batch bursts and assert p95(backlog,5m) on the dashboard. I'll add a CI harness entry.

mona: cache smoke: 3 identical cache gets for hot key -> expect 1 alert within 12m. Will wire into CI smoke job.

julia: I'll open tracking ticket and set daily check-ins until 72h after last rollout. Please post one-line status each morning: "kevin: proxy canary OK | liam: scheduler PR open | mona: cache PR merged"

alert-bot: Ticket created RI-11300: https://redwood.internal/pm/RI-11300. Reminder set: daily check-in 09:00 UTC until 1775626800 (72h window end).

kevin: quick q - 12m vs 15m for cache dedupe? leaning 12m to avoid masking replay storms.

mona: 12m OK for exact-key; keep 15m for connection level. I'll document both in runbook.

liam: adding a rollback guard in the PR: if suppressed_alerts > 3% AND error_rate spikes >2x, auto rollback canary and notify oncall.

julia: thanks all. include dashboard + CI smoke links in PR descriptions. daily pings start tomorrow. thread locked for edits.
